DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about boarding?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが寝ています。ベビーカーをどう扱うか、乗る前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眠る子どものベビーカーの扱いを事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child is asleep. I'd like to check how to handle the stroller before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in advance about handling a sleeping child's stroller. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 利用される便を伺って、乗務員に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's ask which service you're taking and check with the crew.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この券の便です。いきなり畳むと起きるので、先に手順を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 券で便を示し手順を先に知りたい理由を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The service on this ticket. Folding it suddenly would wake my child, so I'd like to know the steps first.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the service on your ticket and explain why you want the procedure in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車両と混み具合によって案内が変わる場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The instructions may differ depending on the vehicle and how crowded it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前と同じだと思い込まないで、今回の車両の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去の経験を今回の車両にそのまま適用しないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume it's the same as before; I'll listen to the instructions for this vehicle.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide not to apply past experience directly to the current vehicle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物もベビーカーに載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also have luggage on the stroller?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 下のかごにあります。畳む必要があれば、荷物を出してから子どもを抱きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物の収納場所と畳む場合の準備を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's in the basket underneath. If I need to fold it, I'll remove the luggage before picking up my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain where the luggage is stored and how you will prepare if folding is necessary. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実際の乗り方は乗務員の指示に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the crew's instructions for actually boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、入口をふさがず待ちます。案内を聞いてから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口を空け乗務員の案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll wait without blocking the entrance. I'll move after hearing the instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the entrance clear and await the crew's guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 乗務員へ確認しておきます。入口を空けたまま、実際の乗り方の案内をお待ちください。それでは、よいお出かけを。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll check with the crew. Please keep the entrance clear while waiting for boarding instructions. Have a good outing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の担当変更で質問はあるか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Any questions about today's assignment changes?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が応援に入ると聞きましたが、誰の作業を引き継ぐのか聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 応援の指示で引継ぎ相手を聞き取れなかったと質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard I'll be providing support, but I couldn't catch whose work I'm taking over.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about not catching whom to take over from in the support instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一人の作業をそのまま引き継ぐのではなく、補助に入ってもらう予定だ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're planning for you to assist, rather than take over one person's work in full.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 引継ぎ担当だと思っていました。指示を受ける相手は誰でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 補助役だと理解し指示を受ける相手を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I was taking over. Who will be giving me instructions?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the support role and ask who will direct you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現場のリーダーに確認してから配置を決める。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll decide the assignment after checking with the floor leader.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認前に持ち場を離れず、現在の作業の区切りも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認前に離れず現作業の区切りも共有する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't leave my station before confirmation, and I'll explain where I can pause my current work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Stay until confirmation and share a suitable stopping point in your current work. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いまどこまで進んでいる。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: How far have you got now?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資材の点検途中です。結果を残してから応援に向かいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資材点検途中で記録を残してから移りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm partway through inspecting materials. I'd like to leave a record of the results before going to help.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that material inspection is in progress and you want to record it before moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 了解。点検を途中のままにしないよう、配置と時刻を調整する。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. I'll adjust the assignment and timing so the inspection isn't left unfinished.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 点検の記録を用意します。応援先が決まったら、役割を復唱して確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配置決定時に補助役割を復唱すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare the inspection record. Once the support location is decided, I'll repeat my role back to confirm.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will repeat the support role back once the assignment is decided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 点検の記録を残し、応援先が決まったら役割を確認してくれ。配置と時刻を調整してくる。では、後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Leave the inspection record and confirm your role once the support location is decided. I'll arrange the assignment and timing. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換えの経路をご確認ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you checking a transfer route?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この「徒歩」を含めて、ずっと電車に乗っていると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩区間も乗車時間と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I'd be on trains the whole time, including this section marked 'walking.'
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the walking section was also train-riding time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そこは歩いて移動する区間です。乗る列車とは分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's a section you travel on foot, separate from the trains you ride.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列車内で休める時間ではないんですね。大きな荷物があるので、その区間を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物があるため徒歩区間の詳細確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it isn't time when I can rest on the train. I have large luggage, so I'd like to look at that section.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request details of the walking section because you have luggage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 経路の詳細を開いて、出入口を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's open the route details and check the entrances and exits.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出る口と次に入る口が別です。改札内を歩くだけだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 出入口の違いから改札内移動という思い違いを訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: The exit and the next entrance are different. I thought I'd just be walking inside the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Correct the assumption that the walk was inside the gates, based on the different entrances and exits. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この経路は外へ出る案内です。券の扱いも窓口でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: This route directs you outside. Please also check ticket handling at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 移動経路と券の相談を分けて聞きます。今の案内だけで乗換えを急ぐのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 経路と券の扱いを別々に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask about the route and the ticket separately. I won't rush to transfer based only on this guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will ask separately about the route and ticket handling. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の経路をご希望でしたら、条件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you want another route, let's check your conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 歩く区間の短い経路も知りたいです。所要時間だけでなく荷物を運べるかで選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間だけでなく荷物と歩行距離で経路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'd also like a route with less walking. I'll choose based on whether I can carry my luggage, as well as travel time.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a route based on luggage and walking distance as well as time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 徒歩区間と荷物の条件を添えて、経路案内の担当へおつなぎします。券の相談は移動方法が決まってからお願いします。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you to route guidance staff with your walking-section and luggage requirements. Please ask about the ticket after deciding how to travel. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの通路を空けていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you keep this passage clear?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。子どもと動物を一緒に撮ろうとして、後ろの人を止めていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影で通行を止めたと認め謝罪する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sorry. I was stopping the people behind me while trying to photograph my child and the animal together.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Acknowledge and apologize for blocking passage while taking photos. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず通れるように、立ち位置を変えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please change where you're standing so people can pass.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 移ります。子どもも柵に寄り過ぎていたので、こちらへ呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影位置を移し子どもを柵から呼び戻す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll move. My child was also too close to the fence, so I'll call them back here.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move your photography position and call your child back from the fence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 撮影より先に、お子様の位置を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check your child's position before taking photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。子どもには写真のために近づかなくてよいと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真のために近づかないと子どもへ説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll explain to my child that they don't need to move closer for the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain to your child not to move closer for a photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 動物が離れているときも、声や物で呼び寄せないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even if the animal is far away, don't use your voice or objects to lure it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 呼ぶのはやめます。動物が自然に見えるまで、無理に撮りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 動物を呼び寄せず自然に見える機会を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll stop calling it. I won't force a photo; I'll wait until the animal is naturally visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not call the animal over; wait for a natural viewing opportunity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかのお客様の見学も妨げないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also avoid interfering with other visitors' viewing.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚撮ったら場所を譲ります。待つときも通路の端に寄ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一枚撮ったら譲り待機位置も通路端にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give up the spot after one photo. I'll stay at the edge of the passage while waiting too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Yield the spot after one photo and wait at the passage edge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、周りに気をつけてお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy your visit while watching out for others.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の資料をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the documents for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 持ってきましたが、去年とその前の年の紙が混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談資料に異なる年の書類が混在すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought them, but papers from last year and the year before are mixed together.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that documents from different years are mixed in your consultation materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの年について相談したいのか、先に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, let's confirm which year you want to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 去年の分です。二年分を足した金額をメモしてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 対象年を示し二年分を合算した誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last year. I mistakenly wrote down an amount combining both years.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the relevant year and explain the mistake of combining two years. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その合計は使わず、書類の年の表示で分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't use that total. Separate the papers by the year printed on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分けます。ただ、この一枚は日付が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 年で分けた後に読めない日付を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. But I can't read the date on this one.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After sorting by year, ask about an unreadable date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 判断できない書類は、発行元への確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: For documents you cannot identify, you need to check with the issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 日付を推測しないで、分からない書類だけ別にしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明書類を推測せず別に保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I won't guess the date; I'll keep only the unidentified documents separate.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not guess about unidentified documents; store them separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた分と未確認の分が分かるようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please make it clear which have been confirmed and which have not.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、去年の資料だけ並べます。未確認分は相談時にもそのまま伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済み対象年資料と未確認分を区別して提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I'll lay out only last year's documents. I'll also explain the unconfirmed ones as they are during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Present confirmed documents for the relevant year separately from unconfirmed ones. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 対象年の資料と未確認の資料を分けたまま、申告相談の担当へお持ちください。受付での整理は以上です。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-SABAE-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Keep the relevant year's materials separate from the unconfirmed papers and take them to the tax-return consultation staff. That completes reception's sorting. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗船券をお手元にご用意ください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please have your boarding tickets ready.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分を私が持っています。同行者が券なしで先に並んでしまいました。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者の券を自分が持っていると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have both people's tickets. My companion has already joined the queue without theirs.
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you have your companion's ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行者はまだ改札の手前にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your companion still before the ticket checkpoint?

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、列の途中です。私が列を横切って渡しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者が列内にいる状況と券の渡し方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, partway along the queue. Is it all right for me to cross through it to hand over the ticket?
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your companion is in the queue and ask how to hand over the ticket. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 列を横切らず、同行者にいったん戻っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you have your companion come back for a moment instead of crossing the queue?

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 戻ってもらいます。私の券と取り違えないよう、名前も見て渡します。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 列を戻ってもらい券名義を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll ask them to come back. I'll check the name too when handing it over so I don't mix it up with my ticket.
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them to return from the queue and compare the ticket name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 券を渡した後は、それぞれご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-07.translation: After you hand it over, please each keep your own ticket.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。帰りの券も一緒ですが、今日使うものだけ出します。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路の券を分け本日分だけ出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. The return tickets are together with them, but I'll take out only the ones for today.
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate return tickets and take out only today's tickets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日付と便名を見て、残りはしまっておいてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the date and service name and put the others away.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日の便を二人で確認しました。今度は一緒に列へ並び直します。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 双方の便を確認し一緒に並び直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-10.translation: We've both checked today's service. This time we'll rejoin the queue together.
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check both people's services and queue again together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらから順にお進みください。どうぞよい船旅を。
DLG-SC-FKI-TSURUGA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please proceed in order from here. Have a pleasant voyage.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その箱、使う前に中を見たか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did you look inside that box before using it?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空でした。でも魚の名前が貼ってあるので、その種類専用の箱ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空箱の魚名ラベルが用途指定か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was empty. But it has a fish name label, so is it a box reserved for that species?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the fish-name label on an empty box designates its use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 昨日使った表示が残っているだけだ。今日の指示票を見よう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That's just a label left over from yesterday's use. Let's look at today's instruction slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ラベルだけで分類するところでした。古い表示は剥がしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残存表示と知り除去の可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I was about to sort by the label alone. May I peel off the old label?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the label is left over and check whether it can be removed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 消してよい表示か確認してから頼む。保管用の番号は残す必要がある。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check whether it's a label you may remove first. The storage number needs to remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 魚名と箱番号を区別します。番号まで剥がさないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 魚名表示と箱管理番号を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll distinguish the fish name from the box number. I'll check so I don't peel off the number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the fish-name label from the box management number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の仕分けを始める前に、空箱の状態も確認してくれ。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the empty box's condition before starting today's sorting.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 底に割れを見つけました。この箱は使わず、担当に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 底の割れを報告して箱を使用停止にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've found a crack in the bottom. I won't use this box and will tell the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report the crack in the bottom and stop use of the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: いい判断だ。置き場を分けて、使わないことを表示しよう。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Good judgment. Let's place it separately and mark it not for use.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 魚を入れる前に見つけられました。交換する箱もラベルと底を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 交換箱でも表示と状態を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I found it before putting fish inside. I'll check the replacement box's label and bottom too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the replacement box's labeling and condition too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 割れた箱は使わない表示を残して担当へ渡してくれ。交換する箱もラベルと底の確認を頼む。では、また後で。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Leave a do-not-use label on the cracked box and hand it to the person in charge. Please check the replacement box's label and bottom too. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの魚を二尾でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like two whole fish of this kind?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いえ、二人分の切身を二枚のつもりでした。言い方が曖昧でしたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二尾ではなく二人分の切身二枚と訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: No, I meant two fillets for two people. My wording was unclear.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Correct your order to two fillets for two people rather than two whole fish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切身の商品でしたら、あちらをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please look over there for the fillet products.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ魚でも、骨の有無は商品によって違いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切身の骨表示について尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Even for the same fish, does whether there are bones differ between products?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about bone labeling on fillets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示を確認しましょう。骨が完全にないとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the label. They may not be completely boneless.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、骨なしと思い込まず、食べるときにも確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 骨なしの思い込みを避け食べる際も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I won't assume there are no bones, and I'll check when eating too.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid assuming they are boneless and check while eating too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 厚さにも違いがあります。使うお料理はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The thickness varies too. Have you decided how you'll cook them?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人とも焼いて食べます。厚さが近い二枚を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ調理に使うため厚さの近い二枚を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We'll both eat them grilled. I'd like two pieces of similar thickness.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request two pieces of similar thickness because they will be cooked the same way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらとこちらを見比べてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please compare this one and this one.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この二枚にします。二尾ではなく、切身二枚でお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 選んだ切身の枚数で注文を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take these two. Two fillets, please, not two whole fish.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm your order by the number of selected fillets. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 尾数ではなく切身二枚のご注文で承りました。こちらをお包みします。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've taken your order for two fillets rather than two whole fish. I'll wrap these for you. Thank you. Please come again.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 追加のご注文はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to order anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この皿を追加したいのですが、隣の人も同じものを頼んでいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追加品が同行者の注文と重なるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to add this dish, but did the person next to me order the same thing?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether an extra dish duplicates your companion's order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お連れ様のご注文を確認いたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人に聞く前にまとめて頼みそうでした。少し待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人に聞いてから決めるため注文を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I nearly ordered for both of us before asking them. Please wait a moment.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Hold the order while you ask the person before deciding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: もちろんです。まだ追加の注文は通していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Of course. I haven't sent through any additional order yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同行者はもう満腹だそうです。二人分を追加するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 満腹の同行者の分を追加しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My companion says they're already full. I won't add portions for two.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not add food for your full companion. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様ご自身のお召し上がりになる分はいかがしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: What about the amount you would like to eat yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は少し食べたいです。一皿の内容を見てから決めてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の注文に必要な一皿の内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like a little. May I decide after seeing what's in one dish?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what a dish contains to decide your own order. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メニューの写真と品名でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll explain using the photo and item name on the menu.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内容が分かりました。私の分だけ一皿お願いします。同行者の追加はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分用一皿だけと注文範囲を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand what's in it now. Please bring one dish just for me. Nothing extra for my companion.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the order's scope as one dish for yourself only. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 追加は一皿ですね。ごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: One extra dish, then. Please enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値段の表示についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the price display?

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この袋が表示の値段だと思いましたが、レジでは違いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示価格と袋の会計額の差を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought the displayed price was for this bag, but it was different at the register.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between the displayed price and the bag's checkout amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示は一個当たりです。袋には複数入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The display is per item. There are several in the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋全部の値段ではなかったんですね。単品で買えるものもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 単価表示を理解し単品販売を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it wasn't the price for the whole bag. Are any sold individually?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand the unit price and ask about individual sales. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 単品の売場を確認します。袋を開けて分けるのはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the individual-item section. Please don't open the bag to separate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 袋は開けません。使うのは一個なので、単品がなければ買う量を考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未開封を保ち単品がない場合は量を再検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't open it. I only need one, so if there are no individual ones, I'll reconsider the amount I buy.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Keep the bag unopened and reconsider the quantity if individual items are unavailable. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらに単品の商品がありました。大きさも比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have individual items here. Please compare the size too.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらの一個で足ります。袋の商品を棚へ戻してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要量の単品を選び袋商品の返却を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one will be enough. May I return the bagged product to the shelf?
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the needed individual item and ask about returning the bagged product. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私がお預かりします。レジで登録済みなら訂正をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take it. If it's already been scanned, please request a correction at the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ会計していません。袋をお渡しして、一個だけ登録してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未会計の商品を戻し一個だけ登録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't paid yet. I'll hand you the bag and have just one item scanned.
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the unpaid bagged product and ask for only one item to be entered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示の単位にもお気をつけください。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-FKI-TSURUGA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Please also pay attention to the units on the price display. Come again.
